payload.name: Signal Cost Asymmetry
payload.fact: Signal cost asymmetry is the structural condition in which the cost of ambiguous communication is transferred from emitters to receivers.
payload.boundary: Applies to organizational signal environments where ambiguity persists despite generating inefficiency.
